description: Reviewed npm audit exceptions, read by release/scripts/npm-audit-with-exceptions.mjs. Only the infra/aws audit steps in .github/workflows/tuf-local-gates.yml and tuf-publish.yml and the apps/ehr audit in tuf-local-gates.yml use it; every other npm audit runs plain npm audit --audit-level=moderate. An entry covers one advisory in one package, at npm's exact vulnerable range, severity and installed paths, in one audited directory, until expires_at (00:00 UTC). An uncovered advisory, an expired entry or a stale entry fails the audit; an entry with dependent_paths also fails when the advisory reaches a package path it does not list, and one with ends_when_fix_published fails once a fixed version is published. See docs/STAGING_BACKEND_BUILDS.md.

exceptions.justification: Denial of service through crafted glob patterns (globparts amplification, CWE-405). This minimatch (10.2.5) is bundled inside aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0 and runs only while CDK synthesizes infra/aws, in three places: asset exclude patterns (IgnoreStrategy), the bundling-stacks context patterns (Stack.bundlingRequired) and construct-id selectors. The patterns come from this repository's source and CDK context, and the strings matched are this repository's construct paths and asset file paths, so no outside input reaches minimatch. infra/aws is not copied into any runtime image, its node_modules are not in the TUF publication tooling archive, and its one Lambda asset (runtime/workload-issuer) is two source files with no CDK code. The worst case is a slow synth on a developer or CI machine.
exceptions.fix_status: No fix available. aws-cdk-lib 2.273.0 (pinned), 2.274.0 and 2.275.0 (latest on 2026-11-01) bundle minimatch ^10.2.5 or ^10.2.6, below the fixed 11.0.1, and npm overrides cannot replace a bundled dependency. Remove this entry when infra/aws moves to an aws-cdk-lib release that bundles minimatch 11.0.1 or later.
exceptions.approved_by: D-Eminence (in chat, 2026-11-01; re-approved for the reworded range in chat, 2026-11-04: "Q32 yes")

exceptions.justification: Regular expression denial of service through single-branch repeated extglobs. picomatch 4.0.7 is installed in apps/ehr only as build tooling: npm ls picomatch --all shows it only under vite 8.2.4 (directly and through tinyglobby 0.2.17 and fdir 6.5.0), all devDependencies, and npm also lists @vitejs/plugin-react 6.1.1 because it peers on vite. It matches glob patterns from vite's own configuration and this repository's files at build time, never input from a user. Evidence, 17 November 2026, from origin/staging-novu-ci-20261005 73eae090: npm --prefix apps/ehr test passed, HID_PUBLIC_BASE=/ npm --prefix apps/ehr run build completed and its release-binding check passed, and none of the 10 files in apps/ehr/dist contains picomatch's source strings (picomatch, POSIX_REGEX_SOURCE, REGEX_NON_SPECIAL_CHARS, 'Expected pattern to be a non-empty string'), which the same search finds in apps/ehr/node_modules/picomatch/lib. npm ls picomatch --omit=dev --all is empty for apps/ehr, and npm ls picomatch --package-lock-only --omit=dev --all is empty for every one of the 27 package-lock.json directories, all 11 services (whose images install with npm ci --omit=dev) included; every picomatch in a lockfile is marked dev.
exceptions.fix_status: No fixed version exists: 4.0.7 is picomatch's latest release (dist-tag latest on 17 November 2026) and is in the vulnerable range. The entry has ends_when_fix_published, so the gate fails as soon as a release outside <=4.0.7 is published; then upgrade vite or override picomatch in apps/ehr and remove this entry.
